reading: The SIGNED feedback response is a per-sightline directional axis: within StrongAGN, sightline-to-sightline spread (SR=0.83) is comparable to the between-recipe shift (NOT a per-recipe constant), and a real residual axis survives absorption control (SR_resid=0.68, |Spearman(s_4, total_abs)|=0.41 < 0.5). Worth scoping a future signed-response embedding track (separately, defense-panel-gated). CEILING: characterizes the DIRECTION of feedback action per sightline; does NOT beat the ~0.45 4-class classification ceiling and claims nothing about it.
noiseless_data: S/N=inf — R_c is the exact physical feedback response
